npcLines: Welcome to the library. How can I help you?
Hello! What can I do for you today?
turns.translation: Chào mừng đến thư viện. Tôi giúp gì được cho bạn?
accepted: I would like to get a library card
I'd like to get a library card
I want to join the library
How can I get a library card
turns.hint: Try: I would like to get a library card.

npcLines: Certainly. Do you have some form of identification with you?
No problem. Do you have an ID with you?
turns.translation: Chắc chắn rồi. Bạn có mang giấy tờ tùy thân không?
accepted: Yes, I have my ID card
Yes, I do. Here it is
turns.hint: Try: Yes, I have my passport.

npcLines: Your card is ready. You can borrow five books for three weeks. Do you have any questions?
All done. You may borrow five books for three weeks. Anything else?
turns.translation: Thẻ của bạn đã xong. Bạn mượn được năm cuốn trong ba tuần. Bạn có thắc mắc gì không?
accepted: Can I renew the books online
How can I renew the books online
Can I extend the loan online
turns.hint: Try: Can I renew the books online?
